name: Connected Grid
description: Scroll-driven staggered image grid where each photo scales up from a corner as it enters, with captions sliding in from the side, laid out on an 8-column grid with smooth scrolling.
contents: Grid of image figures placed by row, column and span, each with title and year caption
behavior: Each frame scales from a top corner while the inner image zooms out, scrubbed by scroll
Captions slide in and fade, direction depends on whether the item sits left of the previous one
Below 53em the grid collapses to a single column
editableByProps: Images, titles, years and grid placement of every item
Background, text, title and year colors
Column count, gap, image ratio, scroll range, easing and smooth scroll

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the breakpoint where the grid becomes a single column
needsCodeEdit.where: min-width:53em media query in the css string
gsap timeline with fromTo calls inside gridItems.forEach

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is on, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Relies on the ScrollTrigger plugin and page scroll for the reveal
